segments.name: U.S. Secure Services
segments.description: Owns, leases and manages U.S. secure facilities under public-private partnerships with government agencies, providing security, administrative, rehabilitation, education and food services.
segments.evidence: Our U.S. Secure Services segment primarily encompasses our U.S.-based public-private partnership secure services business.

segments.name: Electronic Monitoring and Supervision Services
products: radio frequency, GPS, and alcohol monitoring devices
segments.description: Provides electronic monitoring, case management and supervision services in the U.S., including monitoring devices, on behalf of government agency partners.
segments.evidence: Our Electronic Monitoring and Supervision Services segment, which conducts its services in the U.S., consists of our electronic monitoring and supervision services.

segments.name: Reentry Services
products: temporary housing, programming, employment assistance and other services
segments.description: Runs community-based and reentry programs and centers, offering supervision, temporary housing, programming and employment assistance so residents can reintegrate into the community.
segments.evidence: Our Reentry Services segment consists of various community-based and reentry services.

segments.name: International Services
segments.description: Runs public-private partnership secure facilities and related services in Australia and South Africa for government agency partners.
segments.evidence: Our International Services segment primarily consists of our public-private partnership secure services operations in Australia and South Africa.

revenueModel.text: Government agencies pay the company for managing secure facilities, reentry services and electronic monitoring and supervision programs under public-private partnership contracts.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company derives most of its revenue from the management of secure facilities through public-private partnerships.
